title: MCU/allied-party support march for the constitutional referendum
reason: Manual’s political-rally exclusion: the opened report describes multiple political parties demonstrating in support of the President’s referendum/constitutional position, with the referendum scheduled for July 30.
notes: This is not excluded merely because it was pro-government or referendum-related. The report expressly names the MCU and several allied parties, the upcoming July 30 vote, and a support purpose. It reports no distinct demand directed against the government; the march is an expression of support for the planned process.
